key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ: four, part of the expression indicating a very large number
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the central act of worship being described
key_terms.بَابٍ: a gate, meaning an entrance, aspect, or avenue

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام mean by saying that salat has four thousand gates?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام states that salat possesses innumerable dimensions, conditions, meanings, and paths of understanding. The hadith highlights the عظمة and depth of salat, indicating that it is not a simple act but a vast field of worship and knowledge.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.598 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
Prayer has four thousand gates (aspects or elements)”.
